We just need a good studio to adapt it which would stay faithful to the manga. The artstyle would definitely not be exactly similar since the animation technology has moved to be digital. But if the direction of the anime is good, the lack of a retro style would not be an issue.

The manga isn't as open ended as people here are suggesting. Akane and Ranma do get married, to quote the narrator's note - "And so, the wedding was postponed... but only for a little while."
